title: Analysis of mannosidase I activity in interphase and mitotic cells by lectin staining and endoglycosidase H treatment
protocol: Seed WT and MAN1 QKO CHO cells on coverslips in 6-well plates.
Incubate cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 overnight (16–20 h).
Transfect CHO cells as described.
Aspirate the medium.
Add 1.5 ml PBS per well to rinse the cells.
Aspirate the PBS.
Add 1.5 ml of 1% (w/v) PFA fixation buffer per well at room temperature.
Incubate for 15 min.
Collect PFA buffer with a pipette and dispose it in the aldehyde waste disposal.
Add 1.5 mL of PBS per well and wash thoroughly.
Aspirate the PBS.
Add 1.5 mL of 50 mM NH4Cl quenching buffer per well at room temperature and incubate for 10 min.
Aspirate the quenching buffer.
Add 1.5 mL of PBS per well and wash thoroughly.
Aspirate the PBS.
Repeat step adding 1.5 mL of PBS, washing, and aspirating three times in total.
Add 1.5 mL of PBSB blocking buffer per well at room temperature and incubate with gentle rocking for 30 min.
Aspirate the blocking buffer.
Transfer coverslips with a fine-tip tweezer to a 24-well plate.
Add 500 μL of 2 μg/mL PHA-L in PBSB per well and incubate for 30 min with gentle rocking in a 4°C cold room.
Wrap the plate with aluminum foil during incubation.
Aspirate the PHA-L solution and transfer coverslips to a 6-well plate.
Add 1.5 mL of PBS per well and wash with gentle rocking for 5 min.
Repeat washing step three times, extending or repeating if non-specific signal is detected.
Rinse the coverslips with Milli-Q H2O.
Mount the coverslips on slides with Moviol.
Keep the slides in dark and allow the Moviol to dry completely overnight at 4°C.
Image with NIS-Elements C confocal microscope using a 60× oil lens with Z-stacks at 0.3 μm intervals.
Seed MAN1 QKO CHO cells on glass-bottom dishes as described in “Before you begin - splitting and seeding cells”.
Incubate cells at 37°C and 5% CO₂ overnight (16–20 hours).
Transfect CHO cells as described in “before you begin – Transfection of cells”.
Change medium to complete growth medium containing 150 ng/mL nocodazole 6 hours after transfection.
Incubate cells at 37°C and 5% CO₂ for 18 hours.
Change medium to imaging medium containing 150 ng/mL nocodazole for live cell imaging.
Place the glass-bottom dish in a live-cell imaging chamber at 37°C with 5% CO2 coupled to a Nikon ECLIPSE Ti2 Confocal microscope.
Observe under a 60× oil objective to identify mitotic cells.
Save the locations of the mitotic cells.
Wash the cells extensively by adding excess (1 ml) imaging medium containing 100 μg/mL CHX to the empty space in the dish and removing it with a vacuum system.
Repeat washing step for three times.
Incubate cells with imaging medium containing 100 μg/mL CHX and 2 μg/mL rhodamine-PHA-L.
Seed WT and MAN1 QKO CHO cells as described in “before you begin - splitting and seeding cells”.
Incubate cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 overnight (16–20 h).
Transfect CHO cells as described in “before you begin – Transfection of cells”.
Maintain the transfected cells.
Check growing status and viability of the cells.
Split cells on Day 2 if necessary.
Collect conditioned media from days 4 to 5.
Spin the medium at 1,000 g at 4°C for 3 min to remove dead cells.
Wash 200 μL of HisPurTM Ni-NTA resin with 1 mL His-binding buffer.
Mix the supernatant with prewashed Ni-NTA resin and transfer to a new tube.
Incubate with gentle rotation at 4°C for 2 h.
Spin at 1,000 g at 4°C for 3 min to collect the Ni-NTA resin.
Resuspend the resin with 1 mL His-binding buffer.
Transfer the resuspended resin to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Wash the Ni-NTA resin with 1 mL His-binding buffer by gently inverting the tube 3–5 times.
Spin at 1,000 g at 4°C for 3 min.
Discard the supernatant carefully without disturbing the Ni-NTA resin pellet.
Repeat steps three times.
Add 150 μL His-elution buffer and mix well with Ni-NTA resin.
Spin at 1,000 g at 4°C for 10 min.
Collect 135 μL supernatant carefully without disturbing the resin.
Add 15 μL of 10× glycoprotein denaturing buffer (New England Biolabs).
Heat at 95°C for 5 min.
Incubate reaction solutions at 37°C on a shaker for 1 h.
Terminate reactions by adding 12 μL 6× SDS loading buffer.
Heat at 95°C for 3 min.
Run 5–10 μL of each sample on a 9% SDS-PAGE.
Transfer proteins to 0.45 μm nitrocellulose membranes.
Probe sHF-LIPA with a mouse monoclonal anti-FLAG antibody.
